value.rationale: The regular dodecahedron is a canonical, highly symmetric Platonic graph, and the adjacent third-level dodecahedral and fourth-level Heawood computations motivate this precise fourth-level question. An exact integral homotopy classification beyond grid/square-sequence families, with a six-dimensional complex collapsing to 154 five-spheres and a symmetry character distinguishing involutions of identical vertex cycle type, is a meaningful structural invariant and a nontrivial benchmark.
